info.name: Yaazh Cab Booking API v1
info.description:
Postman collection for Yaazh Cab Booking REST API (cPanel / MySQL).

1. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:3000).
2. Run Auth requests — tokens are saved automatically.
3. Use Customer / Driver / Admin folders with saved bearer tokens.
